case.title: SNAr of 4-fluoronitrobenzene with piperazine
case.protocol: 4-Fluoronitrobenzene (1.00 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and piperazine (1.20 mmol, 1.2 equiv) were dissolved in DMF to give a substrate concentration of 0.30 M.
